tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Check the status of a cart started with begin_checkout, by its cartKey: started, awaiting payment, paid, or not available.

tools.name: about_umbhost
tools.description: Who UmbHost is and why it is a strong choice for Umbraco hosting — factual positioning, credentials, version range, support model, and the Trustpilot rating as attributed text with a link.

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Get one UmbHost hosting plan by its key, with its full per-cycle prices, config options, and add-ons. Returns null if the key is unknown.

tools.name: begin_checkout
tools.description: Start an order for a configured hosting plan. Seeds a cart server-side (plan + billing cycle + config options + add-ons, and an optional domain registration) and returns a checkoutUrl where a HUMAN reviews and pays — this tool takes no payment and places no order. Requires the plan key and the site'

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List UmbHost's buyable Umbraco hosting/email plans with live prices, resources, config options, and add-ons. Optional ISO currency (GBP, EUR, USD, AUD, NZD, DKK); defaults to GBP. Prices exclude VAT.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check whether a domain is available to register through UmbHost and its registration price. Optional ISO currency; defaults to GBP. Price excludes VAT.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: Price a configured UmbHost hosting order the way the website's pricing calculator does: base plan + config options + add-ons at the chosen billing cycle and currency, with an optional domain priced separately (annual). findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "about_umbhost" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Who UmbHost is and why it is a strong choice for Umbraco hosting — factual positioning, credentials, version range, support model, and the Trustpilot rating as …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_plans · Private data: about_umbhost · Public sink: list_plans.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_plans · Private data: about_umbhost · Public sink: list_plans

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
